title: Build agents and harnesses
question: Which coding agents can a Composer user actually hand work to, at what published version, with which model ids the agent's own catalogue still lists?

previousCheck.what: The comparison run recorded the three configurations it executed: Codex CLI 0.145.0 with gpt-5.6-sol and gpt-5.6-terra, and an ingested OpenCode agent trial.

entries.label: Codex CLI
entries.observed: Installed at ~/.local/bin/codex returns "codex-cli 0.145.0". The vendor's latest release is rust-v0.169.0, published 2026-11-13T08:37:05Z. The installed harness is therefore behind the published one; the comparison run pinned 0.145.0.
entries.composerHandoff: The maintained Hello recipe codex-github-cloudflare-hello-v2 targets Codex on an Apple Silicon Mac (src/lib/project-setup.ts).

entries.label: OpenCode
entries.source: command -v opencode; ls ~/.opencode/bin; GET https://api.github.com/repos/sst/opencode/releases/latest; GET https://models.dev/api.json
entries.observed: No opencode binary is on PATH and ~/.opencode/bin does not exist, so no local CLI version could be read. The vendor's latest release is v1.19.5, published 2026-10-28T06:17:49Z. This session itself runs inside an OpenCode host agent, which is why the compare page recorded it as "host agent runtime" with no CLI version.
entries.reason: The harness is present only as the host runtime. Its CLI version and its own tool surface could not be executed or read from a local installation in this session, so only the published release and the provider's model catalogue are asserted.
entries.composerHandoff: Composer's fresh-agent evaluation wires the codex and opencode CLIs and nothing else (scripts/eval-fresh-agent.mjs); the tutorials name a supported Codex or OpenCode agent.

entries.label: Claude Code
entries.observed: No claude binary is on PATH. The npm registry reports the published package version 2.1.325 for @anthropic-ai/claude-code. No model id, tool list or Composer handoff is asserted.
entries.reason: Not installed here and no Anthropic account was used, so nothing about its current model ids or capabilities was observed. Only the published package version was readable, which is not evidence that a Composer task can be handed to it.
entries.composerHandoff: Not named in Composer's maintained recipe, fresh-agent evaluation or MCP setup; it appears only as a docs search keyword (src/lib/docs-hub.ts).

limits: The three inventories were read in one bounded pass on 2026-11-16 between 02:15Z and 02:41Z. Row timestamps name the pass, not each request; the exact read time is on each source.
No inference was run for this inventory. No model token was spent, so an id being listed is not evidence that a trial with it would succeed today.
Two further Codex catalogue records are marked visibility "hide" (gpt-reserve, codex-auto-review) and are not asserted as usable here.

The Codex catalogue was written by client 0.164.0, while the installed CLI reports 0.145.0. The list is the vendor's current published catalogue for the account, not a capability claim about the older binary.

Five of the eight listed Codex ids are also named on the vendor's public models page or changelog. gpt-6-sol, gpt-6-luna and gpt-5.6-luna appear only in the client's freshly fetched catalogue and are recorded on that evidence alone.
Claude Code and the OpenCode harness stay unverified until a local installation is actually executed.
